messages:
Maya: Quick async pulse for the Acme on‑prem tenant rollout — want a short milestone/status readout. Main asks: networking (egress/NAT), airgap image sync + signing, canary smoke, and CR/owner for any remaining blockers. @Jorge @Elena @Akshay please ping owners.

Jorge: Network update: firewall rules staged, infra has confirmed ports 443/8443 open. Still waiting on customer's NAT team to provide static egress IPs for source-allowlist. I asked Network-CX for the CIDR list yesterday, no reply yet.

Network-CX: sending the CIDRs today, sorry for the lag — will post in this thread once we have them.

Elena: Airgap side: image bundle pushed to the staging S3 mirror but fails the signature verification on the customer's airlock host. Error: "signature mismatch". Looks like the signing key used by our release pipeline isn't the same key on the onprem verifier.

Akshay: Filing a CR to rotate the verifier trust bundle and publish the new key thumbprint. CR-4872 assigned, owner: akshay. ETA for key rollout — end of day tomorrow (COG: needs ops review).

Maya: Thanks. Can someone post the quick checklist we need the customer to confirm before cutover? I want one small action list we can send to the customer success rep.

Jorge: Short checklist I use: 
1) Provide egress static IPs/CIDRs
2) Confirm firewall allows outbound 443 to our update endpoints
3) Ensure admin user has SSH jump access for smoke 
4) Verify time sync (NTP) on airgapped hosts
5) Share a reachable test VM for initial smoke tests

Elena: Also ask them to run this verifier command on the verifier host and paste output: 

```
/usr/local/bin/verifier --check-key --key-thumbprint=EXPECTED_THUMBPRINT
```

Akshay: SRE note: ran the canary in staging earlier; SRE-Bot reported one failing healthcheck (redis auth). I left a small snippet in the deploy run: 

SRE-Bot: canary-check: redis auth failed on node svc-cache-02. Logs: "AUTH ERROR: invalid credentials". Cause: secret sync missed during bundle push.

Maya: Ok — action items from thread: 
- @Network-CX: post CIDR(s) (Jorge will re-run firewall smoke after we have them)
- @Akshay: CR-4872 progress + share key thumbprint to Elena
- @Elena: attempt re-sign with current pipeline key once thumbprint posted and re-run verifier command
- @Jorge/SRE: once CIDR posted, re-run canary, check redis credentials sync (credential sync job id?).

Jorge: I'll re-run the firewall + canary smoke after CIDR arrives. If redis auth still fails, I'll escalate to infra oncall.

Network-CX: CIDRs posted: 198.51.100.0/26, 203.0.113.64/28. Let me know if you need a specific IP instead of the block.

Akshay: Posted CR update: CR-4872 -> key-thumbprint: ab12cd34ef56. I also kicked off the trust-bundle rollout to staging (job #7421). ETA prod rollout pending successful verifier run.

Elena: Re-signed bundle with new key, re-pushed to staging mirror. Ran verifier locally against the customer's sample VM (they gave us access) — passes. Next: coordinate with customer to run verifier command in their environment, then we'll schedule the production canary.

Maya: Great. If everything passes verification and redis creds are fixed we can proceed with the canary window tomorrow morning. I'm flagging this for the day shift. Thanks all — I'll summarize and send to CS. :thumbsup:

Jorge: quick note — if NAT mapping requires a single IP instead of blocks, ping me ASAP.

Akshay: noted. If anyone hits more infra secrets issues, tag me and I'll re-run the secret-sync job (job id: secret-sync-2026-03-17).

Maya: Closing the async loop — will follow up with a short customer-facing checklist and timing. If anything urgent, drop here or ping me directly.
